Rescale the Scores of a Fit by the Leverage

Source: R/sandwich_hc23.R
sandwich_adjusted.Rd

Computes the scores \(s_i^*\) of hc2_sandwich() (or of the CR2, CR3 and HC4 variants) and, for CR2, the closure that evaluates the Satterthwaite degrees of freedom.

Usage

sandwich_adjusted(
  fit,
  design,
  Vb,
  cols,
  g,
  id,
  sw,
  expected,
  emethod,
  lev_info = NULL
)

Arguments

fit

The StatmodFit().

design

The design of the fit.

Vb

The inverse penalized information over the coordinates cols.

cols

The positions, among the coefficients stacked by equation, of the coordinates that Vb covers.

g

The list of weighted scores of statmod_score_obs().

id

NULL or the cluster numbers.

sw

The SandwichMethod object.

expected, emethod

The information that the bread was built from.

lev_info

The information of the leverage: the roots \(W_i^{1/2}\) and the inverse \(K^{-1}\) of the hat matrix are read on it. NULL takes the information of the bread.

Value

A list with g, the list g with the rescaled scores in the place of the originals, and df_fn, NULL unless the type is CR2 with a t reference, otherwise a function of the positions (among cols) that returns the degrees of freedom there.
